# Configuration reference

`.aicd.yaml` at the root of the repository. Every key is optional. Priority, lowest to highest:
defaults → `.aicd.yaml` → environment variables → `--set key=value`, then capped by the organisation
policies (`extends`). Any scalar or list key can be set from the environment: `agents.triage.autonomy` →
`AICD_AGENTS_TRIAGE_AUTONOMY` (lists are comma-separated).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `extends` | string |  | Organisation policies: a file path or an https URL. |
| `plugins` | list of string | `[]` | Plugin packages to load (installed in the repository). |
| `llm.provider` | string | `"anthropic"` | anthropic \| openai \| ollama \| none \| a plugin provider |
| `llm.model` | string | `"claude-opus-5-5"` |  |
| `llm.effort` | `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `xhigh` \| `max` | `"medium"` |  |
| `llm.budget_per_run_usd` | number | `0.3` |  |
| `llm.base_url` | string |  | OpenAI-compatible servers (Ollama, vLLM…). |
| `llm.api_key_env` | string |  | Name of the environment variable holding the key. |
| `llm.prices.input` | number |  |  |
| `llm.prices.output` | number |  |  |

# Organisation policies

Referenced with `extends:` (file path or https URL). A repository can lower these ceilings, never raise them.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autonomy_max` | map of `observe` \| `advise` \| `propose` \| `act` or map of `observe` \| `advise` \| `propose` \| `act` | `{}` | Per agent (or `default`); an agent acting on environments may take one level per environment. |
| `forbidden_actions` | list of string | `[]` |  |
| `llm.allowed_providers` | list of string |  |  |
| `llm.max_budget_per_run_usd` | number |  |  |
| `privacy.send_code_max` | `none` \| `diff_only` \| `full` |  |  |
| `plugins.allowed` | list of string |  | Only these plugins may be loaded. |
